text: Assumption: After calling Finish() or Cancel(), the context remains in the configured state and can be reused for another call of Start() with the same key — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: After calling Finish() or Cancel(), the context remains in the configured state and can be reused for another call of Start() with the same key — is this correct?
norm: after calling finish or cancel the context remains in the configured state and can be reused for another call of start with the same key
assumption: After calling Finish() or Cancel(), the context remains in the configured state and can be reused for another call of Start() with the same key.
rationale: SWS_CRYPT_22110 merely requires a context initialized via SetKey() for Start(), but does not define an automatic unloading of the key after Finish().

original.text: Annahme: Nach dem Aufruf von Finish() oder Cancel() verbleibt der Kontext vermutlich im konfigurierten Zustand und kann für einen erneuten Aufruf von Start() mit demselben Schlüssel wiederverwendet werden — trifft das zu?
